title: EMS OTA Manager Configuration
description: OTA firmware update settings: staging directory, A/B partition management, Ed25519 package verification, HTTP download parameters, post-update health check, and persistent state path.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must be '1.0'.

staging.description: Temporary staging area for downloaded and extracted OTA packages.

dir.description: Absolute path to the staging directory. Created automatically if it does not exist.

max_package_mb.description: Maximum allowed OTA package size in megabytes. Downloads with Content-Length exceeding this are rejected immediately.

partition.description: A/B partition configuration for atomic over-the-air updates.

boot_flag_path.description: Absolute path to the JSON boot-flag file. Written atomically via tmp+rename. Records active slot, previous slot, boot count, and health-check status.

active_device.description: Block device path for the currently active partition slot (e.g. /dev/mmcblk0p2).

standby_device.description: Block device path for the standby (write target) partition slot (e.g. /dev/mmcblk0p3).

security.description: Cryptographic security settings for OTA package verification.

public_key_hex.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 public key for verifying OTA manifest signatures. Replace with the real key at commissioning.

download.description: HTTP download settings for firmware package retrieval.

timeout_s.description: Total download timeout in seconds. Applies to the complete download, not individual chunks.

chunk_size.description: HTTP streaming read chunk size in bytes.

progress_interval_s.description: Minimum interval in seconds between download progress log messages.

health_check.description: Post-update health verification after reboot into the new partition.

timeout_s.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for all services to become healthy after reboot.

poll_interval_s.description: Interval in seconds between health check polls.

services.description: List of systemd service unit names that must be active before confirming the update.

state_path.description: Absolute path to the JSON file recording current firmware version, previous version, and OTA state machine state.
